title: rocket trips 🚀
content: The airport is also a launch space for space ships. I’ll go into a rocket and shoot up to the moon. I usually bring someone with me to experience it. Every time we go, I’m enjoying it and not scared. Even if something crazy is happening, like last week when I was launched up without being strapped in, Lol. I’ll go and look at Earth from the rockets view and then I never really remember going down. I just remember getting off the rocket once I’m back and recapping the experience with friends in the world.
